moments.title: Spain wins World Cup 2026
moments.blurb: Spain defeated defending champions Argentina 1-0 in extra time to win the FIFA World Cup 2026 final in New York/New Jersey on July 19.

angles.name: Winner's Glow
angles.copy: Still buzzing from Spain's epic World Cup win last Sunday! That 1-0 extra-time victory over Argentina was pure football drama. Where were you when the goal went in? #WorldCup2026

angles.name: Final Recap
angles.copy: Six days on, and we're still talking about the FIFA World Cup 2026 final. Spain lifting the trophy after beating Argentina – what a tournament it was! Did it live up to the hype for you?

moments.title: The Open Championship 2026 Recap
moments.blurb: The 154th Open Championship concluded last Sunday, July 19, at Royal Birkdale Golf Club, where New Zealander Ryan Fox claimed the Claret Jug.

angles.name: Golf Glory
angles.copy: What a weekend for golf! The Open Championship at Royal Birkdale saw Ryan Fox take the Claret Jug on Sunday. A brilliant performance for the New Zealander!

angles.name: Birkdale memories
angles.copy: Royal Birkdale delivered another classic! Ryan Fox's victory at The Open Championship on Sunday was a fantastic end to a thrilling tournament. Who else was glued to the final round?
